fields.why: The text ranks 2016-2017 rate changes across 5 race/ethnicity groups, 7 age groups, 6 urbanization levels and 6 sex-by-age cells ('largest relative change occurred among blacks').
Sex enters only through the sex-by-age cells, which the text ranks as one set ('males aged 25-44 years'), so rule 3 counts them; counts match the Table 1 rows.

The z-tests and the gamma-CI overlap rule test 2016 vs 2017 within each group, a non-SPD contrast that makes no groupwise entry (rule 6); the cross-group claims are rankings only. The mechanical flag is a false hit: the CI-overlap assertion is not across SPD groups.

brief_issues: The mechanical check flags side by side whenever the record has a CI-overlap assertion; it should check whether that test is across the SPD levels or a within-group period contrast.
